PGC NRV 2/12 includes legally irrecoverable input VAT in **initial book acquisition cost**; later definitive-prorrata and investment-good adjustments do not change that initial valuation. Binding V0055-19 uses PGC acquisition cost for directly attributable commissioning expenses when applying article 108, but does not expressly decide whether a decisive irrecoverable-VAT component itself crosses the VAT cutoff. That exact application remains unconfirmed. The uncertainty cannot change the monetary result where known acquisition costs before any VAT already reach 3,005.06, or where even those costs plus **all** related VAT remain below 3,005.06. Thus 3,100 before VAT passes that limb; 2,400 + 504 VAT = 2,904 fails it under either treatment. These bounds do not themselves establish recoverable VAT or override the asset definition and exclusions. Keep a decisive partly/nonrecoverable-VAT amount separate instead of importing accounting capitalisation as automatic VAT classification. ([LIVA 108](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1992-28740#a108); [DGT V0055-19,section 2](https://petete.tributos.hacienda.gob.es/consultas/?num_consulta=V0055-19); [PGC NRV 2/12](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2007-19884).)

changes.after: **Classify the initial correction before calculating it.** In an established activity, delayed first use is included in the article 107 adjustment window. For an ordinary annual prorrata change with the intended destination unchanged and fixed business allocation, articles 107/109 retain the strictly more than 10 percentage point test and the 5/10 divisor. A building with 21,000 input VAT, 100% business use, acquisition definitive P40% and later first-use definitive P60% gives `(21,000×60%−21,000×40%)/10=420` additional deduction in the first-use year's final return; 40%→50% gives no article 107 adjustment. These results are also produced by AEAT's actual later-use calculator. They do not establish a full 4,200 reset merely because commissioning is delayed. ([LIVA 107/109](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1992-28740#a107); [AEAT calculator, annual investment-good option](https://www2.agenciatributaria.gob.es/wlpl/AVAC-CALC/CalculadoraProrrata), read 27 October 2026.) changes.after:
A proved change of the intended destination **before** the asset enters use has a separate route. Binding DGT V0835-25 section 4 applies articles 99.Dos/114 to correct that initial deduction **once**, when the change becomes known, if no relevant article 9.1(c)/(d) self-supply applies; a change after use begins follows the staged investment-good procedure. If the independently established entitlement before first use changes from 8,400 to 12,600 under that initial-correction route, the increase is 4,200 without dividing by 10. An annual turnover-based P movement alone does not prove that destination-change fact. Genuine pre-activity or a new differentiated sector retains the separately supplied 111–113 method: the whole article 112 correction to the aggregate four-year percentage, then article 113 adjustment for only remaining capital-good years. ([DGT V0835-25,section 4](https://petete.tributos.hacienda.gob.es/consultas/?num_consulta=V0835-25); [LIVA 99/114](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1992-28740#a99); [111–113](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1992-28740#a111).)

Keep evidence of the original use allocation, original definitive deduction, subsequent actual business-use fraction and the sector's current definitive deduction percentage separately. Determine whether new evidence corrects the original entitlement or proves a genuine later change; V1330-17's initial-error recovery must not be automatically divided by5. Apply the existing fixed-use prorrata adjustment to the affected input pool and the statutory use-change procedure to genuine later use changes. Do not add two complete original-to-current adjustments for the same input or introduce a universal10point test on the productU×P. ([LIVA arts.95/107–110](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1992-28740#a95); [DGT V1330-17](https://petete.tributos.hacienda.gob.es/consultas/?num_consulta=V1330-17)).

**Both later changes cross their own gates.** For a genuine later change within the original adjustment window, first establish the lawful reference U0/P0/deduction and the current supported annual Uy/Py. Test the change in U and the change in P separately. For a same-year-acquisition/use reference, general prorrata or the shared-business limb of special prorrata, and changes **each strictly greater than 10 percentage points**, compare the two complete entitlements once: signed additional deduction=`(V×Uy×Py−D0)/N`, where `D0=V×U0×P0`, `N=5` or 10 for land/buildings, and `V` is the original VAT **before either fraction**. V is distinct from the already business-restricted input pool used in the fixed-use formula above. For building VAT 21,000, original U50%/P40% gives D0=4,200; current U70%/P60% gives 8,820, so the annual additional deduction is 462. AEAT's actual calculator returns 462 for those inputs. Do not add another complete U correction and P correction to that result. ([LIVA 95/104/106/107/109](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1992-28740#a95); [AEAT annual investment-good calculator](https://www2.agenciatributaria.gob.es/wlpl/AVAC-CALC/CalculadoraProrrata), read 27 October 2026.)

A 10-point change does not pass either separate gate. With original U80%/P80% and current U90%/P90%, neither gate passes, despite the product rising 64%→81%; the tested calculator returns zero. Where both U and P change but **only one** exceeds 10 points, the exact treatment of the other fraction remains unconfirmed: the calculator's observed use-only output on a 40%-prorrata asset omits the prorrata restriction, so it is not used to certify a universal formula. Preserve each fraction and the original deduction rather than substituting a gate on U×P. Exclusive-entitling/exclusive-exempt allocation under special prorrata, initial-entitlement corrections, disposals and the separately disputed delayed-use reference require their existing route. ([LIVA 95/104/106/107](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1992-28740#a95); [actual calculator and instructions](https://www2.agenciatributaria.gob.es/wlpl/AVAC-CALC/CalculadoraProrrata).)
